# Metro Highway

> Metro Highway is a free, browser-based ambient drone synthesizer, rhythm machine and step sequencer with an embedded low-poly cyberpunk racing game. It runs entirely in the browser (Web Audio API), needs no account or installation, works offline as a Progressive Web App, and sends no data anywhere.

## What it does
- Subtractive synth engine with presets (pianos, organs, strings, brass, woodwinds, mallets, synths, guitars, lo-fi textures, drones, nature sounds) and user-saved presets
- Humanize and Drift (organic timing, velocity and pitch variation), Lo-Fi character with Motion, stereo chorus, multi-head tape-style echo
- 16-step rhythm machine (patterns, drum kits, polyrhythm, auto-randomize), 16-step melodic sequencer, slow drone chord sequencer, many scales
- Keyboard input (mouse, touch, computer keyboard, MIDI where supported), hands-free generative "Auto Drone" mode, WAV recording
- VFD Racing: a low-poly driving minigame that also runs as a tempo-synced visual

## Facts
- Price: free. License: all rights reserved, © 2026 egoaid
- Platform: any modern browser with Web Audio support (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari; desktop and mobile)
- Install: "Install" / "Add to Home Screen" in the browser (PWA); offline after first load
- Privacy: audio is generated locally; presets are stored in the browser's local storage only
- Manual: footer "MANUAL" link inside the app (English and Japanese)
